record.body:
## Rationale

`web-calm` is the layout milestone, and its phases through task-graph are done. This phase repairs the FastAPI write path. Leaving `milestone` unset keeps the repair off that layout group.

## Counter-argument

The bug is in the web app `web-calm` shipped, so filing the phase under `web-calm` would keep later web repairs with the milestone that introduced the server. The milestone record is still `planned`. Grouping this write-path fix there would mix it with layout work that is already finished.
